site.machinery: world.js makeCountry(iso3) with COUNTRY_VENUE_ASSIGNMENT.MEX === 'chinampas'; farmed strips cut by two water channels and a cross channel, with bridge crossings and a boardwalk landing

independence.statement: A fictional NemoWorld space. It is not a government, ministry, embassy or United Nations office, it does not represent any country or people, and nothing here asserts endorsement, representation or official status.

notes: Farmed strips cut by channels at x = 30 and 31 and y = 17, a boardwalk landing with a moored hull, and a walkable raising bed.
The water tiles are declared, so a solid fixture placed on working water is refused unless it declares placement.on water, which is how a mooring is allowed and a bench is not.
